window.name: Remittance
window._headerExtraNote: ETP-6148 — «Datos para el fichero SEPA» below the header form (artifacts/remittance/custom/RemittanceSepaFileData.jsx): the chosen account's IBAN (read-only with a lock hint, or an input that saves it ON THE ACCOUNT when missing) and the computed SEPA creditor identifier. No BIC (user decision). Contract in sepaFileDataApi.js.
window._noHeaderBorderNote: ETP-6148 round 3 (user decision) — the header fields sit flush on the page like Sales Invoice, which declares the same option, not inside DetailView's default rounded, bordered card.
window._maxDetailLinesNote: ETP-6148 round 3 — import-only lines (the return-material-receipt pattern): no «+ Añadir línea». Lines have no POST and only come from «Seleccionar desde factura». Needed since amount became editable (editInPlace), which put it in addLineFields.entry and made DetailView show the add-line area.

confirm.label: confirm
confirm._note: ETP-6247 — «Confirmar» (was ETP-6148's «Procesar»): RemittanceHeaderHandler action `confirm`, atomic: it checks fileReadiness, processes the remittance with REM's REMRemittanceProcess, leaves the payments in Remesado and the invoices uncollected (the remittance ends Pendiente de envío PR and can be reactivated until «Marcar como cobrada»), generates the SEPA file and stores it as the main attachment. `confirmModal` routes the click to customComponents.processConfirmModal (RemittanceProcessConfirmModal), which re-checks fileReadiness, asks the grouping from `params` (default P «Sin agrupar», GGPD «Agrupar por cliente y vencimiento», posted as fieldValues.grouping), warns that the payments stay in Remesado until it is marked collected, posts the action itself and offers the file in its success step. Only while unprocessed and with lines.

markSent.label: remittanceAdvanceToSent
markSent._note: ETP-6247 — NOT a header button any more (`exclude`: the generator emits no process for it): the step is chosen from the header status chip (RemittanceStatusSelector, window.customComponents.topbarExtra) and from the grid's row menu. The entry stays declared because the route and the selector read its label and displayLogicRaw as the single source of the step's visibility. «Pasar a Enviada al banco». RemittanceHeaderHandler action `markSent` (PR -> SB, informational: nothing is created or settled). Data key remittanceStatus (evalDisplayLogicRaw lower-cases the first letter). confirmModal routes it to RemittanceProcessConfirmModal -> RemittanceSentDialog (the two chips «Pendiente de envío -> Enviada al banco» and what it does), which posts the action itself.

markCollected.label: remittanceAdvanceToCollected
markCollected._note: ETP-6247 — NOT a header button any more (`exclude`, see markSent): chosen from the status chip selector and the row menu. «Pasar a Cobrada». RemittanceHeaderHandler action `markCollected` (SB -> CT/PT: settles every payment at the remittance's due date and the invoices become collected). The UI no longer offers it straight from PR (the backend still allows it). confirmModal routes it to RemittanceProcessConfirmModal -> RemittanceCollectDialog (the chips «Enviada al banco -> Cobrada» and the settlement warning), which posts the action itself. The label stays «Cobrada» for a payment remittance too: the process label is static.

reactivate.label: reactivate
reactivate._note: ETP-6148 — «Reactivar»: RemittanceHeaderHandler action `reactivate` (deletes the payments the process created; the remittance becomes editable again; ETP-6247: only from Pendiente de envío PR or Enviada al banco SB, otherwise 422 ETGO_RemittanceReactivateNotAllowed). Danger style, so DetailView asks for confirmation through customComponents.processConfirmModal (RemittanceProcessConfirmModal). ETP-6247: only while the remittance is Pendiente de envío (PR) or Enviada al banco (SB); it is written as «not PE/CT/PT/CP/PP/AN» on the data key remittanceStatus (evalDisplayLogicRaw lower-cases the first letter and has no OR).

returnLines.label: remittanceReturnAction
returnLines._note: ETP-6247 returns — «Devolver»: the bank did not collect some receipts of a confirmed remittance. confirmModal routes the click to customComponents.processConfirmModal (RemittanceProcessConfirmModal), which opens RemittanceReturnDialog; the dialog reads returnState + the lines, picks them, and posts RemittanceHeaderHandler action `returnLines` itself. Shown only on a Cobrada (CT) or partially collected (CP) remittance, never before it is collected (data key remittanceStatus, written as «not PE/PR/SB/PT/PP/AN» because displayLogic has no OR). A payment remittance cannot be told apart from the record, so the dialog says so when returnState.collection is false.

transactionDate.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Fecha' (Datetrx): the remittance date. Mandatory, but never typed by the user: NeoMandatoryDefaultsService injects the AD default (@#Date@, today) on create, and the remittance handler may set it explicitly.

remittanceType.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Tipo de remesa' (REM_Remittance_Type_ID). Its identifier already reads 'Remesa de cobro' / 'Remesa de pago', so it covers both the direction (collection/payment) and the SEPA scheme in the list without a derived column. Cascades on financialAccount: the selector request carries FIN_Financial_Account_ID and the remittance handler only offers the types whose SEPA scheme is enabled on that account.

name.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Nombre' (Name). Mandatory, max 60 characters (validated by the remittance handler). The AD field has no read-only logic, so readOnlyLogic @Processed@='Y' locks it on a processed remittance like the other header fields; the remittance handler already refuses that edit (422 ETGO_RemittanceProcessedNotEditable).

financialAccount.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Cuenta' (FIN_Financial_Account_ID). The selector is served by the remittance handler, which decides what it offers: Bank accounts with the remittance payment methods, including those WITHOUT a valid IBAN, whose items carry `ibanValid: false` and show a «Sin IBAN» badge (optionBadge); their IBAN is entered in the «Datos para el fichero SEPA» block, and the header refuses the save (422 ETGO_RemittanceAccountIbanRequired) until it is valid. There is no per-account «Admite remesas» switch any more; Bank accounts get the remittance payment methods when they are created. Placed first in the form because remittanceType depends on it. List: columnWidth 290 fits a typical account name («Cuenta Remesa ETP-6148 - EUR»); `name` absorbs the leftover width (grow), not the account or the type (user decision 2026-11-06).

dueDate.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Fecha de cargo/abono' (Duedate): the date the bank charges (collection) or credits (payment) the remittance. minDate today: the picker disables past days and a typed past date blocks the save (only a NEW value is checked, so an existing remittance with a past date still opens and saves); RemittanceHeaderHandler refuses the same with 422 ETGO_RemittanceDueDatePast.

remittanceStatus.label: Status
remittanceStatus.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Estado' (Remittance_Status, DAL property remittanceStatus, list REM_RemittanceStatus: PE, PR, CT, PT, CP, PP, AN). A column of the remittance module itself (added in ETP-6148 on feature/ETP-6148; the remittance PR must be merged and its module built before this change is deployed), set by REM's own processes; never written by the user. form:false: the header shows the status only as the top-bar pill (statusField), not as a form field. enumValues points every code at an i18n key (genericLabels remittanceStatusPe…An), because the AD list ships English names only and the read-only form select would otherwise show 'Pending' in Spanish; window.statusEnumLabels does the same for the detail status pill. enumVariants gives the grid badge and the status quick filter their per-code tones (PE neutral, PR info, CT/PT success, CP/PP warning, AN destructive); the codes are too ambiguous across windows for the global getStatusTone catalog.

documentNo.reason: ETP-6148 — «Nº documento» (DocumentNo): assigned by the server from the REM_REM document type sequence; shown, never typed. First list column (a real column: sorts and filters on the server) and first header field, by user decision (2026-11-06).

documentType.reason: ETP-6148 — C_Doctype_ID, the client's REM_REM document type. Mandatory; resolved server-side (AD default @SQL ... DocBaseType = 'REM_REM', or the remittance handler defaults).

processed.reason: ETP-6148 — kept in the payload (not shown) because every header field's readOnlyLogic is @Processed@='Y': a processed remittance is locked.

creditorIdentifier.reason: ETP-6247 — REM_REMITTANCE.CREDITOR_IDENTIFIER: the remittance's own SEPA creditor identifier (AT-02), the one its file carries. Writable on create and update while not processed so the custom block can preload it (the account's, else the one computed from the organization) and save it with the general «Guardar»; RemittanceHeaderWrites normalizes and validates it (ETGO_SepaCreditorId* keys), collections only, never written to the account. A blank one is ignored: RemittanceHeaderWrites proposes the account's valid one on create and when the account changes or the type switches between collection and payment (the Classic form gets it from the RemittanceSepaDefaultsCallout callout), and confirm keeps the organization's computed one as the copy. REM_REMITTANCE_TRG no longer defaults it: it only freezes it once the remittance is processed. form:false: the custom block owns it.

directDebitScheme.reason: ETP-6247 — REM_REMITTANCE.DD_SCHEME: CORE | B2B, only for collection remittances (default CORE, set by RemittanceHeaderWrites on the create of a collection, and by the RemittanceSepaDefaultsCallout callout in the Classic form; REM_REMITTANCE_TRG only freezes it once processed). Writable while the remittance is not processed (RemittanceHeaderWrites normalizes it, 422 ETGO_RemittanceSchemeInvalid / ETGO_RemittanceOptionsCollectionOnly); the SEPA file carries it in LclInstrm/Cd. form:false: the custom «Opciones avanzadas» block owns it.

financed.reason: ETP-6247 — REM_REMITTANCE.ISFINANCED (NOT NULL, default N): «Remesa financiada», only for collection remittances. Writable while not processed; the SEPA file's GrpHdr/MsgId carries the financed prefix. form:false: the custom «Opciones avanzadas» block owns it. Stays required as the AD says (quality-gate invariant): with form:false it is not in the header form's save gate, and an untouched switch leaves it to the column default N.

iBAN.reason: ETP-6247 — REM_REMITTANCE.IBAN: the remittance's own IBAN, proposed from the account by RemittanceHeaderWrites on create and when the account changes or the type switches between collection and payment (the Classic form gets it from the RemittanceSepaDefaultsCallout callout; REM_REMITTANCE_TRG only freezes it once processed), and the one its SEPA file always carries. Writable on create and update so the custom «Datos para el fichero SEPA» block can send the IBAN typed for THIS remittance before its first save (RemittanceHeaderWrites normalizes and validates it, 422 ETGO_RemittanceIbanInvalid); never written to the account. form:false keeps it out of the generic form: the custom block owns it.

eTARAutomaticprocess.reason: ETP-6247 — EM_Etar_Automaticprocess (com.etendoerp.automated.remittance, «Process Automated»). A remittance created through GO keeps it N (confirm resets it to N before REM processes it, so the payments are not settled automatically); it becomes Y only on markCollected («Cobrada»), which settles the payments. Kept in the payload (not shown) only so the custom RemittanceStatusBanner can tell a remittance settled by GO's «Cobrada» (whose SEPA file «Confirmar» generated) apart from one settled otherwise; «Reactivar» is hidden by the status (processOverrides.reactivate), not by this flag.

chargedate.reason: ETP-6148 — Classic 'Discount Date', only meaningful for discount (consolidated) remittance types, which Etendo GO does not offer.

singlePayment.reason: ETP-6148 — Classic technical flag (one payment per remittance); NOT NULL with DB default 'N'.

payment.reason: ETP-6148 — the single payment generated by Classic when singlePayment = Y; not used.

selectpayments.reason: ETP-6148 — Classic process button, out of scope (selection of due items is a later task). Discarded so NEO and MCP do not expose the action; processOverrides excludes it too.

createLinesFrom.reason: ETP-6148 — Classic process button, out of scope.

getFile.reason: ETP-6148 — Classic 'Create Remittance File', out of scope (the SEPA XML is built by another team).

processRemittance.reason: ETP-6148 — Classic 'Process Remittance', out of scope (status transitions are a later task).

selectInvoicesAndOrders.reason: ETP-6148 — Classic process button, out of scope.

posted.reason: ETP-6148 — accounting button; remittance types are provisioned with ISPOSTINGALLOWED = N.

lines._methodsNote: ETP-6148 — lines are added only through «Seleccionar desde factura» (no POST/PUT/PATCH, every field readOnly, so DetailView shows no add-line area and no edit). DELETE enables the generic line delete (row trash icon + selection bar); DetailView hides it on a processed remittance (lockWhenProcessed) and RemittanceLinesHandler refuses it there too.
lines._rowEditNote: ETP-6148 round 3 — no row edit mode, as in Classic: no Edit (pencil) action and a click does not turn the row into inputs. The only editable value is «A remesar» (amount.editInPlace), an always-visible input committed by PATCH (methods above; RemittanceLinesHandler writes only amount and refuses with 422 ETGO_RemittanceLineAmountInvalid outside 0 < |amount| <= |due outstanding|). The trash icon (line delete) and «Seleccionar desde factura» stay.

invoiceDate.label: Invoice Date
invoiceDate.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Fecha factura': the invoice date (C_Invoice.DateInvoiced, DAL invoiceDate), read through a property path; yyyy-MM-dd, formatted with formatCalendarDate.

invoiceGrandTotal.label: Invoice Total
invoiceGrandTotal.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Total factura': the invoice grand total (C_Invoice.GrandTotal, DAL grandTotalAmount), read through a property path; formatted with the line currency.

invoiceOutstanding.label: Outstanding
invoiceOutstanding.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Pendiente': the invoice's outstanding amount (C_Invoice.OutstandingAmt, DAL outstandingAmount), read through a property path; formatted with the line currency.

invoiceDocumentNo.label: Invoice
invoiceDocumentNo.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Factura': the invoice number of the due item, read through a property path (no REM column; generic Classic property-path fields). The column that absorbs the leftover width.

businessPartner.label: Customer
businessPartner.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Cliente': the due item's business partner (the one «Seleccionar desde factura» shows), read through a property path; an FK, served with businessPartner$_identifier.

dueDate.label: Due Date
dueDate.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Vencimiento': the invoice payment plan's expected date, the same date «Seleccionar desde factura» shows and filters on (RemittanceDueItems uses expectedDate). Served as yyyy-MM-dd and formatted with formatCalendarDate.

lineNo.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Línea' (Line). Hidden from the Lines tab by user decision (2026-11-06); kept readOnly (still served) because the lines keep their default order by line number.

paymentScheduleDetail.label: Due Item
paymentScheduleDetail.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Vencimiento' (FIN_Payment_Scheduledetail_ID), the due item the line settles. Not a column any more: the Lines tab shows Factura / Cliente / Vencimiento through property paths that start from it (invoiceDocumentNo, businessPartner, dueDate). Still served (the API and «Seleccionar desde factura» rely on it).

payment.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Pago' (FIN_Payment_ID). Hidden on the Lines tab (user decision 2026-11-06, option a): a line created from an invoice due amount has no payment until the remittance is processed, and the grid cannot hide a column based on the header's processed state. Still served.

amount.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Importe'. currencyField names the line's own text currency (REM's SQL-logic Currency, e.g. EUR), which resolveRowCurrency accepts as a plain ISO code, so the cell reads «53,24 €» with the line currency. Header «A remesar» / «To remit» (per-field labels): the part of the due amount this line remits. Round 3: the only editable line value (user decision, Holded pattern), an always-visible input with a reset to the due's outstanding (editInPlace), capped at it; read-only text once the remittance is processed (the document lock).

dueOutstanding.label: Due Outstanding
dueOutstanding.reason: ETP-6148 round 3 — decisions-only path field: the amount of the payment schedule detail the line points to, i.e. the due's outstanding (the bound REM itself checks, REM_OutOfRangeAmount). It is the reset value and the maximum of «A remesar» (amount.editInPlace). Not invoiceOutstanding, which is the whole invoice's outstanding and is wrong for an invoice with several dues. Not a column.

invoice.reason: ETP-6148 round 3 — the Classic property field paymentScheduleDetail.invoicePaymentSchedule.invoice, opted in per field (propertyPath) as a hidden read-only path field: it carries the invoice id the Factura column links to (invoiceDocumentNo.link.idField). Not a column.

invoiceSalesTransaction.label: Sales Transaction
invoiceSalesTransaction.reason: ETP-6148 round 3 — decisions-only path field: the invoice's own sales flag picks the Factura link's target window (true: sales-invoice, false: purchase-invoice), read from the invoice itself, not from the remittance type. Not a column.

invoicePaymentSchedule.reason: ETP-6148 — AD_Field property path paymentScheduleDetail.invoicePaymentSchedule (anchor FIN_Payment_ScheduleDetail.FIN_Payment_Schedule_Invoice; its identifier is the due date and amount). Not supported end to end (checked for ETP-6148): the extractor ignores AD_Field.Property and emits the anchor column of the joined table (here FIN_Payment_Schedule_Invoice) as a flat key; push-to-neo only matches columns of REM_RemittanceLine, so the field is skipped; NeoFieldFilter resolves fields with getPropertyByColumnName on RemittanceLine, so NEO never serves it. Enabling it would render an always-empty, unfilterable column.

order.reason: ETP-6148 — AD_Field property path paymentScheduleDetail.orderPaymentSchedule.order; remittances of orders are not offered. Not supported end to end (checked for ETP-6148): the extractor ignores AD_Field.Property and emits the anchor column of the joined table (here C_Order_ID) as a flat key; push-to-neo only matches columns of REM_RemittanceLine, so the field is skipped; NeoFieldFilter resolves fields with getPropertyByColumnName on RemittanceLine, so NEO never serves it. Enabling it would render an always-empty, unfilterable column.

orderPaymentInPlan.reason: ETP-6148 — virtual (SQL logic) column of the order payment plan; payment-plan fields are hidden from the Lines tab and remittances of orders are not offered.

currency.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Moneda' (Currency): REM's virtual SQL-logic column on REM_RemittanceLine. Not a column of its own any more: the amount is formatted with it (amount.currencyField). Still served.

origstatus.reason: ETP-6148 — Classic technical column (payment status before remitting).

status.label: Receipt Status
status.reason: ETP-6148 — 'Estado del recibo': the Classic property-path field payment.status (AD_Field.Property), opted in by "propertyPath": "payment.status" (per-field opt-in). Served as a PROPERTY_PATH row; rendered as a status badge with the payment status labels (genericLabels statusRpap… statusRemSent / statusRemCancel) and getStatusTone. Empty until the remittance is processed (the line has no payment yet). ETP-6247: enumValues repeats the payment status labels the extractor emitted, with RPVOID (the voided payment a return leaves) named «Devuelto» (remittanceReceiptReturned), so a returned receipt reads as returned in the grid.

displayedAccount.reason: ETP-6148 — AD_Field property path ...eTABAMBankaccount.displayedAccount (anchor C_BP_BankAccount.Displayedaccount). Not supported end to end (checked for ETP-6148): the extractor ignores AD_Field.Property and emits the anchor column of the joined table (here Displayedaccount) as a flat key; push-to-neo only matches columns of REM_RemittanceLine, so the field is skipped; NeoFieldFilter resolves fields with getPropertyByColumnName on RemittanceLine, so NEO never serves it. Enabling it would render an always-empty, unfilterable column.

displayedAccount2.reason: ETP-6148 — AD_Field property path ...eTABAMBankaccount.displayedAccount (anchor C_BP_BankAccount.Displayedaccount). Not supported end to end (checked for ETP-6148): the extractor ignores AD_Field.Property and emits the anchor column of the joined table (here Displayedaccount) as a flat key; push-to-neo only matches columns of REM_RemittanceLine, so the field is skipped; NeoFieldFilter resolves fields with getPropertyByColumnName on RemittanceLine, so NEO never serves it. Enabling it would render an always-empty, unfilterable column.
